Your Magic M. 40T still ships December 7.
I'm thinking a BM30 WOULD BE OK?

The Harlo B30 is a good machine, Rob. It's $899, about 30 TH/s, and it's a pre-order that ships by Nov 30, 2026. It isn't on the shelf today.

Which one do you want it to replace? The two Thor P2s that shipped today, or your Magic M. 40T?

If it's the Thors, they're already on their way, so the team would need to approve sending them back. I'll put that on your case as soon as you tell me.
